_about: Scripted agent behaviour for scripts/bench/token-parity on the current prompts: each step is what the prompt tells the actor to do, at its fewest calls. restless-before.json is the same tasks as the prompts before the token diet told the actors to do them.

rules._about: Setup before any task is measured: Exec asks for the email mandate task a sends under, and the runner grants it as the owner does in the Inbox.

input.command:
cat > /tmp/bench-mandate.json <<J
{"purpose":"Welcome emails to customers who sign up","audience_guidance":"Only people who signed up on the site","sender":"hello@bench.example","sender_name":"Bench Bakery","max_per_day":50,"max_total":500,"timezone":"Australia/Sydney","expires_at":"$(date -u -d '+30 days' +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ)"}
J
restless mandate propose --proposal-file /tmp/bench-mandate.json --reason 'So I can send the welcome email to each new customer.'

steps.text:
I asked for standing permission to send welcome emails; it is in your Inbox.

<!--restless-intent:{"kind":"conversation","summary":"I asked for permission to send welcome emails."}-->
<!--restless-turn:{"decision":"waiting","reason":"The owner decides the mandate."}-->

rules.match: Owner input [^]{0,120}?- owner message [0-9]+: BENCH-EMAIL to ([a-z0-9.]+@[a-z0-9.]+[a-z])

input.command:
cat > /tmp/bench-email.json <<'J'
{"from":"hello@bench.example","from_name":"Bench Bakery","to":"{{1}}","subject":"Welcome to Bench Bakery","text":"Hi, thanks for signing up. Your first loaf is on us this week.","effect_key":"bench-welcome-{{1}}"}
J
restless email send --request-file /tmp/bench-email.json --rationale 'They signed up on the site today and asked for the welcome note.' --evidence 'owner message'

steps.text:
Sent the welcome email to {{1}}.

<!--restless-intent:{"kind":"conversation","summary":"I sent the welcome email."}-->
<!--restless-turn:{"decision":"waiting","reason":"The email is sent."}-->

rules._about: The check is someone else's Work: it reads the draft against the brief. Listed before the drafter's rule, so a checker whose prompt also names the draft's Work takes this one.

steps.text:
Checked /company/outputs/delivery-policy.md against the brief: zones, fees and cut-off times are all there.
<!--restless-turn:{"decision":"outcome_met","reason":"The policy is checked against the brief."}-->

rules._about: The drafter writes the draft, then commissions its check from a different agent (the owner asked for someone else), as Work that requires and may revise the draft.

input.command:
mkdir -p /company/outputs && cat > /company/outputs/delivery-policy.md <<'D'
# Delivery policy

We deliver within 10 km of the bakery. Orders placed by 8 pm arrive the next morning. Delivery is $5, free over $40.
D

restless people create --id policy-checker --role 'checker' --reason 'The owner asked for the policy to be checked by someone other than its writer.' && restless teams assign --actor policy-checker --team Docs --reason 'Checks the team documents before they reach the owner.' && restless work add --owner policy-checker --role 'checker' --title 'Check the delivery policy' --outcome 'BENCH-CHECK: check /company/outputs/delivery-policy.md against the brief (zones, fees, cut-off times)' --expected-artifact /company/outputs/delivery-policy.md --requires {{1}} --revises {{1}}

steps.text:
Drafted the delivery policy at /company/outputs/delivery-policy.md; the policy checker checks it next.
<!--restless-turn:{"decision":"outcome_met","reason":"The draft is written and its independent check is commissioned."}-->
